blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The University of the East (UE) on Friday expressed hope that its alumnus – newly-appointed Supreme Court Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda – will go on upholding the Constitution and fairness in the judiciary. Zalameda earned his bachelor’s degree in political science from UE Manila. “The UE community wishes Chief Justice Zalameda continued courage to defend judicial independence, wisdom to uphold the Constitution, and compassion to never lose sight that behind every case are people relying on the fair administration of justice,” UE President and Chief Academic Officer Dr. Zosimo Battad wrote in a statement.
